```{r}

library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}

head(df)
```

```{r}
summary(df)
```

```{r}
ggplot(df, aes(x = factor(fetal_health))) +
geom_bar(fill = "steelblue") +
labs(
title = "Distribution of Fetal Health Categories",
x = "Fetal Health Category",
y = "Count"
)
```
